fluff.overview: The Blessed Order maintained conventional infantry formations equipped with preserved Star League-era weapons and personal armor, fielding platoons that were better armed than most Successor State infantry throughout the late Succession Wars. Mechanized wheeled platoons use wheeled APCs that provide good road speed and adequate armor protection for the infantry squad carried inside. Wheeled transport is cheaper to maintain than tracked or hover alternatives, making these formations a cost-effective choice for garrison duty on developed worlds with solid road infrastructure. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
